The first in a series of Alliterative Animals, and likely the one most people would want anyway, enjoy my ravishing rat heads. And do with them what you want! I'm reaching a point where I feel I can start charging for some things, and yet my love of food and shelter is contrasting with my hatred for IP law. So expect more things released without restrictions like this in the future.

Note: The folder image displays them with the standard head base, but because I didn't make that, I can't release that as freely. I've got simpler, stick-like necks, but you can easily swap in one of those bases if you like.

Note: I selected "CCPDL" because "CC0" is not available. If possible, I would have released it that way instead.

Normaly you have a team of two in WH but i think a single Ratmen fits better in a Dungeon.


<b>Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/enfenix</b>

---
<p>General information</p>

My miniatures are designed to work out of the box with original 28mm Heroquest miniatures.
I always add a version with Heroquest base and one without a base. The weapons and the base are only combined (if possible).
Personally, I now prefer 32mm miniatures. I usually scale them to 112% -115% directly in the slicer.

I am happy about every shared make, especially the painted ones.
By the way i love espresso, so don't hesitate to leave a tip if you like =D

If you are inexperienced with slicer setting, I recommend this one for Ender Printer: http://www.fatdragongames.com/fdgfiles/?p=4934
